about.description:
Glycin allows to decode, edit, and create images and
read metadata. The decoding happens in sandboxed modular
image loaders and editors.

build.script:
meson setup ${MESON_ARGS} \
    --prefix=$PREFIX \
    --default-library=shared \
    --wrap-mode=nofallback \
    -Dvapi=false \
    -Dtests=false \
    -Dglycin-thumbnailer=false \
    -Dglycin-loaders=false \
    -Dlibglycin=true \
    -Dlibglycin-gtk4=false \
    builddir
ninja -v -C builddir -j ${CPU_COUNT}
ninja -C builddir install -j ${CPU_COUNT}

raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: glycin
  version: "2.1.1"
  version_majmin: ${{ (version | split('.'))[:2] | join('.') }}

recipe:
  name: glycin_and_loaders
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://download.gnome.org/sources/glycin/${{ version_majmin }}/glycin-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: 8e8e92e312b14d2c5f3a047bdc5305adcb9931ef0150cf74bf526a3741e6fb32

build:
  number: 2

outputs:

  - package:
      name: ${{ name|lower }}
    build:
      skip:
        - not linux
      script: |
        meson setup ${MESON_ARGS} \
            --prefix=$PREFIX \
            --default-library=shared \
            --wrap-mode=nofallback \
            -Dvapi=false \
            -Dtests=false \
            -Dglycin-thumbnailer=false \
            -Dglycin-loaders=false \
            -Dlibglycin=true \
            -Dlibglycin-gtk4=false \
            builddir
        ninja -v -C builddir -j ${CPU_COUNT}
        ninja -C builddir install -j ${CPU_COUNT}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - gobject-introspection
        - meson >=0.63.0
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - rust
      host:
        - expat
        - fontconfig
        - freetype
        - glib
        - gobject-introspection
        - lcms2
        - libseccomp
        - zlib
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('glycin', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - libexpat
          - libfreetype6
          - libzlib
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - libglycin-2

  - package:
      name: ${{ name|lower }}-loaders
    build:
      skip:
        - not linux
      script: |
        meson setup ${MESON_ARGS} \
            --prefix=$PREFIX \
            --default-library=shared \
            --wrap-mode=nofallback \
            -Dvapi=false \
            -Dtests=false \
            -Dglycin-thumbnailer=false \
            -Dglycin-loaders=true \
            -Dlibglycin=false \
            -Dlibglycin-gtk4=false \
            builddir
        ninja -v -C builddir -j ${CPU_COUNT}
        ninja -C builddir install -j ${CPU_COUNT}
        # Set GLYCIN_DATA_DIR to use loaders from conda environment
        mkdir -p $PREFIX/etc/conda/activate.d
        echo 'export GLYCIN_DATA_DIR="$CONDA_PREFIX/share"' > $PREFIX/etc/conda/activate.d/glycin-loaders.sh
        mkdir -p $PREFIX/etc/conda/deactivate.d
        echo 'unset GLYCIN_DATA_DIR' > $PREFIX/etc/conda/deactivate.d/glycin-loaders.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - gettext
        - gobject-introspection
        - meson >=0.63.0
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - rust
      host:
        - cairo
        - expat
        - freetype
        - glib
        - gobject-introspection
        - libheif
        - libjxl
        - librsvg
        - libseccomp
        - libxml2-devel
        - xorg-xorgproto
        - zlib
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('glycin-loaders', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - libexpat
          - libfreetype6
          - libxml2-16
          - libzlib
          - libseccomp
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          files:
            - libexec/glycin-loaders/2+/glycin-heif
            - libexec/glycin-loaders/2+/glycin-image-rs
            - libexec/glycin-loaders/2+/glycin-jxl
            - libexec/glycin-loaders/2+/glycin-svg

  - package:
      name: ${{ name|lower }}-gtk4
    build:
      skip:
        - not linux
      script: |
        meson setup ${MESON_ARGS} \
            --prefix=$PREFIX \
            --default-library=shared \
            --wrap-mode=nofallback \
            -Dvapi=false \
            -Dtests=false \
            -Dglycin-thumbnailer=false \
            -Dglycin-loaders=false \
            -Dlibglycin=false \
            -Dlibglycin-gtk4=true \
            builddir
        ninja -v -C builddir -j ${CPU_COUNT}
        ninja -C builddir install -j ${CPU_COUNT}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - gobject-introspection
        - meson >=0.63.0
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - rust
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('glycin', exact=True) }}
        - expat
        - freetype
        - glib
        - gobject-introspection
        - gtk4 >= 4.16.0
        - lcms2
        - libseccomp
        - zlib
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('glycin', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('glycin-gtk4', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        by_name:
          - libexpat
          - libfreetype6
          - libzlib
          - lcms2
          - libseccomp
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - libglycin-gtk4-2

about:
  homepage: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glycin
  summary: 'Sandboxed and extendable image loading'
  description: |
    Glycin allows to decode, edit, and create images and
    read metadata. The decoding happens in sandboxed modular
    image loaders and editors.
  license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE-LGPL-2.1
  repository: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glycin

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - haecker-felix
    - danyeaw
    - Hofer-Julian
